mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.SALE_METHOD, P.SALE_STATUS, C1.CATEGORY_NAME AS MAIN_CATEGORY_NAME, C2.CATEGORY_NAME AS MID_CATEGORY_NAME, C3.CATEGORY_NAME AS SUB_CATEGORY_NAME, NVL(OPT.MIN_PRICE, 0) + P.PRODUCT_PRICE AS MIN_PRICE, NVL(OPT.MAX_PRICE, 0) + P.PRODUCT_PRICE AS MAX_PRICE, NVL(OPT.TOTAL_QUANTITY, P.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QUANTITY, NVL(OPT.OPTION_COUNT, 0) AS OPTION_COUNT, IMG.IMAGE_URL AS THUMBNAIL_URL, P.CREATED_DATE, P.UPDATED_DATE FROM PRODUCT P JOIN CATEGORY C3 ON P.SUB_CATEGORY_NO = C3.CATEGORY_NO LEFT JOIN CATEGORY C2 ON C2.CATEGORY_NO = C3.PARENT_CATEGORY_NO LEFT JOIN CATEGORY C1 ON C1.CATEGORY_NO = C2.PARENT_CATEGORY_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, MIN(PRICE) AS MIN_PRICE, MAX(PRICE) AS MAX_PRICE, SUM(QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QUANTITY, COUNT(*) AS OPTION_COUNT FROM PRODUCT_OPTION GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO ) OPT ON OPT.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, IMAGE_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY OPTION_ID, IMAGE_ORDER) AS RN FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE IMAGE_PURPOSE = '대표' ) IMG ON IMG.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND IMG.RN = 1 WHERE P.SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo} AND P.DISPLAY_YN = #{displayYn} ORDER BY P.CREATED_DATE DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.CREATED_DATE FROM PRODUCT_OPTION PO JOIN PRODUCT P ON PO.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO WHERE P.SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo} ORDER BY P.CREATED_DATE DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.SELLER_NO, C1.CATEGORY_NAME AS MAIN_CATEGORY_NAME, C2.CATEGORY_NAME AS MID_CATEGORY_NAME, C3.CATEGORY_NAME AS SUB_CATEGORY_NAME, P.SALE_METHOD, P.BRAND_NAME, P.NO_BRAND_YN, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.INTERNAL_NAME, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.DETAIL_TYPE, P.PRODUCT_DESC, P.SHIPPING_ZIPCODE, P.SHIPPING_ADDRESS, P.SHIPPING_DETAIL_ADDRESS, P.JEJU_SHIPPING_YN, P.DELIVERY_SERVICE_CODE, P.DELIVERY_METHOD, P.BUNDLE_SHIPPING_YN, P.SHIPPING_FEE_TYPE, P.SHIPPING_FEE, P.LEAD_TIME_INPUT_TYPE, P.LEAD_TIME_DAYS, P.SAME_DAY_SHIP_YN, P.SAME_DAY_CUTOFF_TIME, P.SALE_STATUS, P.DISPLAY_YN, P.CREATED_DATE, P.UPDATED_DATE FROM PRODUCT P JOIN CATEGORY C3 ON P.SUB_CATEGORY_NO = C3.CATEGORY_NO LEFT JOIN CATEGORY C2 ON C2.CATEGORY_NO = C3.PARENT_CATEGORY_NO LEFT JOIN CATEGORY C1 ON C1.CATEGORY_NO = C2.PARENT_CATEGORY_NO WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND P.SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo}

SELECT OPTION_ID, OPTION1_TYPE, OPTION1_VALUE, OPTION2_TYPE, OPTION2_VALUE, OPTION3_TYPE, OPTION3_VALUE, NORMAL_PRICE, PRICE, AUTO_PRICE_ADJUST_YN, QUANTITY, SELLER_PRODUCT_CODE, MODEL_NO, BARCODE, STATUS FROM PRODUCT_OPTION WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} ORDER BY OPTION_ID
SELECT OPTION_ID, IMAGE_PURPOSE, IMAGE_ORDER, IMAGE_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} ORDER BY OPTION_ID, IMAGE_PURPOSE, IMAGE_ORDER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT ( product_no, seller_no, sub_category_no, sale_method, brand_name, no_brand_yn, product_name, internal_name, option_yn, product_price, quantity, detail_type, product_desc, shipping_zipcode, shipping_address, shipping_detail_address, jeju_shipping_yn, delivery_service_code, delivery_method, bundle_shipping_yn, shipping_fee_type, shipping_fee, lead_time_input_type, lead_time_days, same_day_ship_yn, same_day_cutoff_time, sale_status, created_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( #{productNo}, #{dto.sellerNo}, #{dto.subCategoryNo}, #{dto.saleMethod, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.brandName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.noBrandYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.productName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.internalName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.optionYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.productPrice}, 0, #{dto.detailType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NULL, #{dto.shippingZipcode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.shippingAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.shippingDetailAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.jejuShippingYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.deliveryServiceCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.deliveryMethod, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.bundleShippingYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.shippingFeeType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, #{dto.leadTimeInputType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.leadTimeDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{dto.sameDayShipYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.sameDayCutoffTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.saleStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO PRODUCT_OPTION ( OPTION_ID, product_no, OPTION1_TYPE, OPTION1_VALUE, OPTION2_TYPE, OPTION2_VALUE, OPTION3_TYPE, OPTION3_VALUE, normal_price, PRICE, auto_price_adjust_yn, quantity, seller_product_code, model_no, barcode, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{optionId}, #{productNo}, #{option.option1Type, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{option.option1Value, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{option.option2Type, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{option.option2Value, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{option.option3Type, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{option.option3Value, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{option.normalPrice, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{option.salePrice}, #{option.autoPriceAdjustYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{option.quantity}, #{option.sellerProductCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{option.modelNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{option.barcode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CASE WHEN #{option.quantity} > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END )
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET DISPLAY_YN = 'N', UPDATED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo} AND DISPLAY_YN = 'Y'
